verdict.rationale: Kick's Bill Pay tab is a read-and-manage view of bills, AP aging and vendor balances synced from Ramp or BILL. The evidence explicitly states Kick does not execute vendor payments itself. There is no evidence of native bill capture, approval routing or payment scheduling, so the AP workflow lives in the third-party tools and this is only adjacent support.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow
